notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content: Reverted to Update 1 for the moment, as there is an error with the Marny song. This will be fixed as soon as possible!

notes.title: Major Update #1.1
notes.content: This is a secondary update to our first major update! And to all our potters, I'm happy to announce that we've finalized recharting all the songs in the game!

notes.title: Major Update #1
notes.content:
[b]We hear you, and thus![/b]
[list]
[*] A majority of the songs have been recharted, with more on the way!
[*] Long note has been added to enhance gameplay!
[*] New UI and VFX elements for the Rythm section!
[*] Several characters have been given new animations!
[*] Several visual effects have been added to the Overworld!
[*] New assets have been added to the Overworld!
[*] Keyboard and mouse support!
[*] Artbook to view the concept art of our game!
[*] And more!
[/list]
